mapper.select: SELECT rule_id, rule_key, rule_name, source_module, source_type, trigger_status, account_code, direction, amount_expr, aux_type, summary_tpl, priority, status, update_by, update_time, remark FROM fin_voucher_rule WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND status = '0' AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY priority, rule_id

SELECT rule_id, rule_key, rule_name, source_module, source_type, trigger_status, account_code, direction, amount_expr, aux_type, summary_tpl, priority, status, update_by, update_time, remark FROM fin_voucher_rule WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY source_type, priority, rule_id

SELECT rule_id, rule_key, rule_name, source_module, source_type, trigger_status, account_code, direction, amount_expr, aux_type, summary_tpl, priority, status, update_by, update_time, remark FROM fin_voucher_rule WHERE rule_key = #{ruleKey} AND del_flag = '0'

choose.when: SELECT invoice_id AS sourceId, invoice_no AS sourceKey, invoice_date AS sourceDate, total_amount AS total_amount, invoice_amount AS amount_excl_tax, tax_amount AS tax_amount, supplier_id AS partnerId, supplier_name AS partnerName, status AS sourceStatus FROM pms_invoice WHERE invoice_id = #{sourceId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT shipment_id AS sourceId, shipment_no AS sourceKey, shipment_date AS sourceDate, total_amount AS total_amount, 0 AS amount_excl_tax, 0 AS tax_amount, customer_id AS partnerId, customer_name AS partnerName, status AS sourceStatus FROM mk_shipment WHERE shipment_id = #{sourceId} AND del_flag = '0'

mapper.select: SELECT period_id, company_id, `year_month`, period_name, status, close_by, close_time, unlock_by, unlock_time, unlock_reason, create_by, create_time, remark FROM fin_period WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY `year_month` DESC

SELECT period_id, company_id, `year_month`, period_name, status, close_by, close_time, unlock_by, unlock_time, unlock_reason, create_by, create_time, remark FROM fin_period WHERE `year_month` = #{yearMonth} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT period_id, `year_month`, period_name, status FROM fin_period WHERE `year_month` < #{yearMonth} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY `year_month` DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_period SET status = 'CLOSED', close_by = #{closeBy}, close_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() WHERE `year_month` = #{yearMonth} AND status = 'OPEN' AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE fin_period SET status = 'OPEN', unlock_by = #{unlockBy}, unlock_time = sysdate(), unlock_reason = #{unlockReason}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE `year_month` = #{yearMonth} AND status = 'CLOSED' AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_voucher WHERE period = #{yearMonth} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_ledger ( account_code, period, aux_type, aux_id, opening_debit, opening_credit, period_debit, period_credit, closing_debit, closing_credit, create_by, create_time, remark ) SELECT cur.account_code, #{yearMonth}, NULL, NULL, COALESCE(prev.closing_debit, 0), COALESCE(prev.closing_credit, 0), COALESCE(cur.debitAmount, 0), COALESCE(cur.creditAmount, 0), COALESCE(prev.closing_debit, 0) + COALESCE(cur.debitAmount, 0), COALESCE(prev.closing_credit, 0) + COALESCE(cur.creditAmount, 0), #{user}, sysdate(), '期末结账自动生成' FROM ( SELECT e.account_code, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'DEBIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS debitAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'CREDIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS creditAmount FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.voucher_id = e.voucher_id AND v.del_flag = '0' WHERE e.del_flag = '0' AND v.status IN ('AUDITED', 'POSTED') AND e.period = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY e.account_code ) cur LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_code, closing_debit, closing_credit FROM fin_ledger WHERE period = #{prevPeriod} AND del_flag = '0' ) prev ON prev.account_code = cur.account_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ledger l2 WHERE l2.account_code = cur.account_code AND l2.period = #{yearMonth} AND l2.del_flag = '0' )

INSERT INTO fin_voucher ( voucher_no, voucher_date, period, voucher_type, source_module, source_type, source_id, source_key, rule_key, user_id, total_amount, entry_count, status, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{voucherNo}, #{voucherDate}, #{yearMonth}, 'MANUAL', 'fin', 'carry_forward', 0, '结转损益', 'carry_forward_profit', 1, #{totalAmount}, #{entryCount}, 'AUDITED', #{user}, sysdate(), '期末自动结转损益' )
mapper.select: SELECT s.subject_code AS accountCode, s.subject_name AS accountName, s.direction AS direction, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'DEBIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'CREDIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS balance FROM fin_subject s JOIN fin_voucher_entry e ON e.account_code = s.subject_code AND e.del_flag = '0' JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.voucher_id = e.voucher_id AND v.del_flag = '0' WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0' AND s.category IN ('INCOME', 'COST') AND v.status IN ('AUDITED', 'POSTED') AND e.period = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY s.subject_code, s.subject_name, s.direction HAVING balance != 0 ORDER BY s.subject_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_closing ( `year_month`, dept_id, check_code, check_name, check_result, check_detail, check_by, check_time, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{yearMonth}, #{deptId}, #{checkCode}, #{checkName}, #{checkResult}, #{checkDetail}, #{checkBy}, sysdate(), #{checkBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: SELECT closing_id, company_id, `year_month`, dept_id, check_code, check_name, check_result, check_detail, check_by, check_time FROM fin_closing WHERE `year_month` = #{yearMonth} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY closing_id
SELECT status FROM fin_period WHERE `year_month` = #{yearMonth} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_ledger SET del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() WHERE period = #{yearMonth}
